title: On slope unstable Fano varieties
summary: For Fano varieties, significant progress has been made recently in the study of $K$-stability, while the understanding of the weaker but more algebraic concept of $(-K)$-slope stability remains intricate. For instance, a conjecture attributed to Iskovskikh states that the tangent bundle of a Picard rank one Fano manifold is slope stable. Peternell-Wiśniewski and Hwang proved this conjecture up to dimension five in 1998, but Kanemitsu later disproved it in 2021.
